_comment: How each site is shown on the TV. mode: native (the page as it is) | wide (a desktop-width page, e.g. 1280 CSS px, scaled to fit) | portrait-fit (a phone-portrait page, e.g. 430x800 CSS px, scaled to the screen's height and centred, with the couch panels at its sides). zoom is a percentage. safeArea is the TV overscan margin in percent of the screen. match is host + path prefix; the longest match wins, and what you save from the player (לשמור לאתר הזה) overrides these.

On a TV only: Krillion's own 'Low-power mode' (its settings page keeps it under this name) is on unless the people chose otherwise.
